text: The set quotient A/R (for an equivalence relation R on A) is a HIT in HoTT satisfying:
choices: it is a set with [a]=[b] iff R(a,b)
it requires A to be finite
explanation: A/R as HIT: point constructor [─]:A→A/R, path constructor eq(r):[a]=[b] for r:R(a,b), and a set-truncation constructor making A/R an h-set. This gives the correct set quotient.
